rca_of_the_issue: Critical bug fixed: In PartsInventory.jsx, the accountOptions useMemo was defined after the useEffect that depended on it. JavaScript hoisting does not apply to let/const declarations inside useMemo/useEffect, causing 'Cannot access accountOptions before initialization' error. Fix: Moved the accountOptions useMemo definition before the dependent useEffect hook.
